#!/usr/bin/env bash
# tiny: a tiny bash CLI
set -u

cmd="${1:-}"
[ $# -gt 0 ] && shift

case "$cmd" in
  greet)
    echo "Hello, ${1:-world}!"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: tiny <greet [name]>" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
